old_value: Flag bit 0 suppresses drawing. Bit 1 selects direct position versus position offset by half the scaled image dimensions. Bit 2 enables the secondary depth-texture path and less-than depth testing; within that path bit 3 disables depth writes. Bit 4 selects a specialized four-stage, two-texgen TEV pipeline. Palette-indexed C4 and C8 formats load the object's TLUT, while ordinary rendering selects color and alpha equations by texture format. Every completed draw restores depth-texture, TEV, vertex-descriptor, and depth-mode state.
new_value: Flag 1 returns before GX setup. Flag 2 treats position as center; otherwise center adds half scaled dimensions. Flag 4 enables Z24X8 replacement and LESS depth; flag 8 suppresses writes there. Without flag 4, depth is ALWAYS/no writes and flag 0x10 selects two texgens/four stages. Combined flags 4+0x10 are not validated: stage-count setup chooses two stages while later TEV programming takes the four-stage 0x10 branch. Special mode disables blending; ordinary paths use source-alpha blending and format-specific equations. Unsupported formats have no default combiner setup. Successful draw disables Z texture only for flag 4 and resets known HSD/GX state, not the complete incoming state.
reason: Correct section ownership, caller preconditions, ordering, narrowing or GX state semantics.
